name: vertical_tiktok
notes: TikTok safe-zone layout (2026-07-03): blurred/darkened static frame fills the whole canvas (V1); item bar band sits at y~220-477 clear of TikTok's top nav; gameplay is a wider crop (full source height, ~55% of source width) at y~477-1573 so the username/description zone only grazes its bottom edge. Geometry from the hand-tuned Vegas vertical_tiktok.tune.json, re-solved for the new layout. zoom/pan/tilt use Resolve's Edit-page units (crop = conformed-image px pre-zoom; pan/tilt post-zoom scaled by conformed/frame size, tilt positive = up); crop_norm are fractions of the source frame; everything is resolution-independent for 16:9 sources. Re-capture after GUI tuning with: resolve_tiktok.py --save
